verdict.rationale: LM Studio's CLI documents overriding some engine load parameters at model-load time, namely GPU offload ratio and context length via `lms load`. That shows the product itself exposes some low-level engine knobs beyond defaults. Nothing in the evidence shows control over memory locking (mlock) or mmap behavior, the story's named examples. missing for 10: documented mlock/mmap toggles, a broader list of engine/runtime parameters, server/API-level exposure of these settings, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can override low-level engine settings like memory locking or mmap behavior instead of being limited to opinionated defaults

citations.quote: Manage your local models, prompts, and configurations
